item.title: 1 new grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 17 Aug 2026 (17 Aug to 23 Aug 2026).

  • University of Amsterdam: PhD, Protest and Political Speech in the Nordics 1930-1970 (Sound of Disagreement)
    University of Amsterdam (UvA), Faculty of Humanities, Department of European Studies · deadline Closed 20 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 38 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus....
